sources.title: Harrier OSS v1 — FuriosaAI Developer Center 2026.4.0b13 documentation
sources.snippet: Harrier OSS v1 # Harrier OSS v1 is a family of multilingual text-embedding models developed by Microsoft. The 0.6B model uses a dense, decoder-only Qwen3 architecture, but it is trained with Harrier's own multilingual, instruction-aware embedding recipe rather than the Qwen3-Embedding training recipe.
